set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: H03.1
Accountable role (person unassigned): Recovery/operations engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Extract reusable backup engineering from O03.3’s institution-specific medium qualification.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H03 (bd-01M4X8M9CTMTKZHBKG8T9E8EDS)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Create catalog/blob-consistent backup sets with source/schema/artifact identities, immutable manifests, exact digests and required policy checkpoint references; unfinished/corrupt copies are never published as valid.
2. Automate bounded copy, retry, scheduling and inventory against a separately permissioned test service/volume with no source-storage mount; qualify ongoing writes, interrupted copies, missing objects and independent access controls.
3. Expose backup success/age/bytes and checkpoint linkage for monitoring; restore consumes these exact outputs. State the physical failure-domain limits: multiple local containers are not off-host durability.
4. Produce the exact versioned bundle consumed by O03.7, including the supported authority capability inventory and policy checkpoint linkage. A local-only or stale checkpoint may be retained as engineering evidence but cannot certify a safely reopenable organization restore; qualification must join the live O03.6 witness before O03.8 passes.

Verification: Automated synthetic backup/retry/corruption tests using isolated backup credentials and stored manifests; institutional-media proof stays O03.3.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H03.1/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md

Blocked by:
- O03.1: bd-01M4W5P9194RGNP7DFGHB7ZK09
- O01.2: bd-01M4W5P7PW6P6NZVCD0TEMRKKP

Recovery-first amendment, 14 October 2026; original acceptance retained. O03.6-O03.8 deliver the current-capability path; full integration and institutional gates remain open.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
